label: A concrete thing that begins to be present has a concrete CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 originating cause
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history of the model, a concrete thing absent at a moment s and present at a strictly later moment t has some concrete CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 originating cause: the thing has a first moment b of presence and the cause gives it being at b. It therefore requires such a first moment (it is false for a thing present on an open interval of dense time). Nothing is required of the cause after b, so it is compatible with existential inertia (Schmid 2021 grants that a change occurs only if some factor causally induces it).
